title.narrative: CG Rep: Transparency & Governance Repeat Project

description.narrative: The development objective of the Second Phase of the Transparency and Governance Capacity Building Project for Congo is to strengthen the capacity of targeted public sector ministries, agencies and accountability structures for improved management of human and financial resources. There are three components to the project. The first component is increased capacity of targeted ministries to manage financial and human resources. The objective of this component is to provide support to further increase transparency and accountability in financial operations through technical assistance, provision of equipment and training in budget and human resources management, and procurement. It also includes technical support to extend the rapid results approach in selected ministries. The second component is strengthened capacity to ensure public sector accountability and transparency. The objective of this component is to support the Independent Governance Observatory, the Governmental Anti-Corruption Commission, the Economic and Financial Commission of Parliament, the Supreme Audit Institution, the State General Inspectorate, Media and selected Non-Government Organizations (NGOs) by providing technical assistance and training to enhance their capacity to monitor governance and anti corruption measures. The third component is monitoring and evaluation system. The objective of this component is to ensure the effective management and coordination of project implementation.
To strengthen the capacity of targeted public sector ministries, agencies and accountability structures for improved management of human and financial resources.
